mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, it indicates a weak labor market that suppresses consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 8.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and contraction in retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods where both PAYEMS and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime characterized by rising FEDFUNDS and persistent inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%), the Federal Reserve's policy shift reduces corporate profit margins and increases discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods meeting trigger condition, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 650,000 units for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces consumer wealth and business investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 55% of instances where HOUST falls below 650.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services that reduces corporate output and earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 90.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary monetary tightening that reduces real interest rates and stimulates economic activity, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over the prior six months indicates a strengthening housing market that boosts consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of periods where HOUST increases over prior six months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
